args.title: Tamarack Components: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Tamarack Components newsletter, its linked article, and the article's companion piece:

• Newsletter: Tamarack Components' latest newsletter spotlights "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to a feature article on the topic and promoting a related webinar.
• Article: In 2026, warehouse pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: The biggest saving from warehouse automation was fewer mis-picks.
